topic: Naruto never got Tsukuyomi, and the reason is the eye-contact rule plus Kabuto steering the Contact fight
title: Itachi Never Put Naruto In Tsukuyomi. Here's Why
description: Itachi had the Mangekyo eyes for Tsukuyomi, and he never cast it on Naruto. The reason fans keep circling back to is the eye-contact rule and the Contact fight where Kabuto was pulling the strings. Was Naruto never the target, or was Itachi holding back?
comment: Was Naruto never the target, or was Itachi holding back? Pick one.

lines.text: Naruto never got Tsukuyomi, even though Itachi had the eyes to cast it.

shot.fallback: Naruto facing a Sharingan user under a dark sky

lines.text: Tsukuyomi needs eye contact, and only a Mangekyo Sharingan user can cast it.

shot.fallback: close up of a Mangekyo Sharingan

lines.text: Itachi said only a Sharingan user from his clan could break it.

shot.fallback: Uchiha clan members with glowing red eyes

lines.text: Sasuke later broke it, which proves the rule was real.
But the bigger clue is Itachi's health.

shot.fallback: pale ninja leaning against a wall

lines.text: Fans say every jutsu drained his life force, and he was already sick.
Even against Jiraiya, he ran instead of casting it.

shot.fallback: two ninja facing off on a rooftop

lines.text: Then came the Contact fight, the one time they actually shared a battlefield.

shot.fallback: Naruto facing Itachi in a clash

lines.text: Kabuto had Itachi back through Edo Tensei, and Itachi attacked on command.
They talked, and the eyes never became the story.

shot.fallback: two ninja talking during a fight

lines.text: The real choice wasn't Naruto's. It was the one pulling the strings.
So was Itachi holding back for Naruto, or was Naruto never the target?

shot.fallback: Itachi and Naruto in a tense standoff

lines.text: My read: Naruto was never the person Itachi needed inside his head.

shot.fallback: Sharingan eyes glowing in the dark

lines.text: Tsukuyomi needed a target, and Itachi never saw Naruto as one.

shot.fallback: Naruto standing firm with blue eyes

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Naruto and Tsukuyomi in the first two seconds
self_check.loop: Last line sets up Tsukuyomi needing a target, which flows back into the Naruto opener
